description: Copy a cell range to another range in the same spreadsheet (same or different tab), like Google Sheets copy and paste-special. Default PASTE_NORMAL copies values, formulas (relative references adjust), formats and merges; pasteType selects one native paste-special mode. Cannot copy between spreadsheets: use sheet-copy-to first. To duplicate a whole tab or workbook use sheet-copy, sheet-copy-to or spreadsheet-copy. Use a1-notation prompt for range syntax.

destinationGid.description: Destination sheet ID in the same spreadsheet; may equal sourceGid

destinationRange.description: Top-left cell (e.g., "E1") or a finite range whose height and width are whole multiples of the (oriented) source; a larger range repeats the source to fill it

pasteOrientation.description: NORMAL, or TRANSPOSE (rows become columns and vice versa)

pasteType.description: What to paste. PASTE_NORMAL (default) = values, formulas, formats and merges; PASTE_VALUES = values only, no formats/formulas/merges; PASTE_FORMAT = format only, excluding data validation; PASTE_NO_BORDERS = like PASTE_NORMAL without borders; PASTE_FORMULA = formulas only; PASTE_DATA_VALIDATION = data validation only; PASTE_CONDITIONAL_FORMATTING = conditional formatting rules only

sourceRange.description: Finite sheet-local A1 range to copy (e.g., "A1:C10"; no sheet prefix, no whole rows/columns)

name: cells-copy

pastedRange.description: A1 range of cells written in the destination sheet
